characters.name: Sir Walter Elliot
characters.description: The proud baronet of Kellynch Hall; vain about rank and appearance, father of Elizabeth, Anne, and Mary.

aliases.text: Sir Walter Elliot, of Kellynch Hall

characters.name: Elizabeth Elliot
characters.description: Eldest daughter of Sir Walter Elliot; socially ambitious and influential in the family.

characters.description: Daughter of Lady Catherine de Bourgh, presented as delicate and reserved

characters.name: Mr. Darcy
characters.description: Fitzwilliam Darcy; reserved, wealthy gentleman of Pemberley; central male figure in courtship with Elizabeth

characters.name: Miss Darcy
characters.description: Mr. Darcy's sister (resident at Pemberley when noted)

characters.name: Colonel Fitzwilliam
characters.description: Colonel Fitzwilliam; Mr. Darcy's cousin and companion during his stay in the neighbourhood

characters.name: Mr. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet's brother; sensible, gentlemanlike man who assists the Bennet family

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet's sister; amiable, intelligent woman and friend to Jane and Elizabeth

characters.name: Mrs. Younge
characters.description: Woman associated with Wickham and the Darcys in town; connected to events at Ramsgate

characters.name: Mrs. Forster
characters.description: Wife of Colonel Forster; connected with Lydia's acquaintance of the regiment

characters.name: Pratt
characters.description: An officer of the militia mentioned among Lydia's acquaintances

characters.name: Chamberlayne
characters.description: Individual (disguised in a prank) mentioned among the officers known to Lydia

characters.name: Mr. Henry Dashwood
characters.description: Patriarch in Sense and Sensibility; owner of Norland; dies early in the narrative

characters.name: Mrs. Dashwood
characters.description: Widow who must relocate with her three daughters after the elder son's succession

characters.name: Elinor Dashwood
characters.description: Eldest Dashwood daughter; sensible, calm, and the family's counselor

characters.name: Marianne Dashwood
characters.description: Younger Dashwood daughter; ardent, romantic, and emotionally open

characters.name: Margaret Dashwood
characters.description: Youngest Dashwood daughter; good-humored and impressionable child

characters.name: Mr. John Dashwood
characters.description: Half-brother of Mrs. Dashwood and inheritor of Norland under the entail; husband of Mrs. John Dashwood

characters.name: Mrs. John Dashwood
characters.description: Wife of John Dashwood (referred to familiarly as Fanny); concerned for her husband's child's interests

characters.name: Harry
characters.description: Young son of Mr. John Dashwood (referred to by given name in the text)

characters.name: Sir John Middleton
characters.description: Neighbouring squire who invites the Dashwoods to Barton Park and hosts entertainments

characters.name: Lady Middleton
characters.description: Wife of Sir John Middleton; of genteel manners and social taste

characters.name: Mrs. Jennings
characters.description: Lady Middleton's mother; outspoken, sociable, and fond of matchmaking

characters.name: Colonel Brandon
characters.description: Neighbour and older gentleman; grave, reserved, and emotionally attached to Marianne

characters.name: Edward Ferrars
characters.description: Friend/acquaintance in the neighbourhood; steady, reserved young man and a potential match for Elinor

characters.name: Mrs. Ferrars
characters.description: Mrs. Ferrars; mother of Edward Ferrars, influential in prospects for her sons

characters.name: Mr. Willoughby
characters.description: Young gentleman associated with Allenham; lively, charming, and the object of Marianne's affection

characters.name: Mrs. Smith
characters.description: Resident at Allenham; elderly woman visited by Willoughby, connected with Allenham Court

characters.name: Robert Ferrars
characters.description: Elder son of Mrs. Ferrars; described as vain and frivolous; marries Lucy Steele

characters.name: Lucy Steele
characters.description: Conniving, socially ambitious young woman who first keeps an engagement to Edward and later marries Robert Ferrars

characters.name: Mrs. Palmer
characters.description: Charlotte Palmer, Mrs. Jennings's daughter; genial, good-humoured, social visitor at the Park and Cleveland

characters.name: Mr. Palmer
characters.description: Charlotte Palmer's husband; droll, cynical, and often ill-natured in manner

characters.name: Fanny Dashwood
characters.description: Mrs. John Dashwood (Fanny), John’s wife; self-interested and attentive to social position

characters.name: Mr. Harris
characters.description: Local apothecary/physician who attends Marianne during her illness

characters.name: Eliza
characters.description: Eliza (the relation of Brandon’s family) — unhappy woman in Colonel Brandon’s past whose fate is recounted

characters.name: Mr. Pratt
characters.description: Tutor/guardian figure associated with Edward and with Lucy’s connections (Longstaple/Plymouth area)

characters.name: Mr. Donavan
characters.description: A physician/apothecary called in at Cleveland (attends the Palmers)

characters.name: Nancy
characters.description: Named servant/maid mentioned in reports of Lucy and household gossip

characters.name: Mrs. Richardson
characters.description: Named acquaintance mentioned among visitors and local society

characters.name: Mrs. Clarke
characters.description: Named acquaintance referenced in conversation

characters.name: Mrs. Burgess
characters.description: Named acquaintance (hostess in Exeter) who shelters Nancy in the narrative

characters.name: William (Middleton)
characters.description: Child of the Middletons (William) mentioned in comparisons of height among children
